title: An eco-friendly approach to soil remediation: evaluating clay–biochar composite for used motor oil removal through kinetic, isotherm, and thermodynamic models
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00404G, Paper
Bzhwen Khalid Majeed, Khasraw Abdullah Rashid, Dler M. S. Shwan
A novel biochar–clay composite from loquat seeds shows strong potential for remediating oil-contaminated soils. It effectively adsorbs hydrocarbons, is reusable, cost-efficient, and aligns with circular economy and soil restoration goals.
